instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a festively decorated room, three friends pose together. On the left, the man with curly hair (R8) in a red polo shirt smiles with Canadian flags painted on his cheeks. In the center, the man with the red bandana (R5) smiles directly forward, draping his arms over the shoulders of the man with curly hair (R8) and the man with glasses (R4) on the right. In the background right, a blurred man in a gray shirt stands with his back to the camera. The scene is illuminated by warm, natural indoor light.
